user.title: PVOutput Publisher Configuration
user.description: Enter your global PVOutput API Key.

add_system.title: Configure Solar System
add_system.description: Map your Home Assistant sensors to PVOutput API parameters. Leave any optional sensors blank if not applicable.

data_description.name: A friendly name for your solar array in Home Assistant.
data_description.system_id: Your PVOutput System ID for this array.
data_description.frequency: How often data should be uploaded to PVOutput.
data_description.notes: Local notes for your own reference (stored locally, not sent to PVOutput).
data_description.v1: Cumulative or daily energy generated in Wh (converts kWh/MWh automatically).
data_description.v2: Instantaneous power generated in Watts (converts kW automatically).
data_description.v3: Cumulative or daily energy consumed in Wh (converts kWh/MWh automatically).
data_description.v4: Instantaneous power consumed in Watts (converts kW automatically).
data_description.v5: Ambient temperature in °C or °F (converts °F to °C automatically).
data_description.v7: Extended data field 1 (requires a PVOutput donation account).
data_description.v8: Extended data field 2 (requires a PVOutput donation account).
data_description.v9: Extended data field 3 (requires a PVOutput donation account).
data_description.v10: Extended data field 4 (requires a PVOutput donation account).
data_description.v11: Extended data field 5 (requires a PVOutput donation account).
data_description.v12: Extended data field 6 (requires a PVOutput donation account).
data_description.c1: Check if your energy sensors (v1/v3) provide lifetime cumulative counter values.
data_description.n: Check if power generation (v2) represents net export rather than gross generation.
